《圣杯誓约》是一款类似《哈迪斯》的动作砍杀Roguelite游戏，游戏以虚构的反亚瑟王时期的传说为背景，将玩家带入一个被腐化的卡美洛世界，与堕落的亚瑟王及其骑士们展开战斗。游戏最大的特色是支持玩家多人联机合作，以各种职业的人物、武器和法术消灭敌人。 [h1]独特而有趣的背景故事[/h1] 《圣杯誓约》的故事发生在腐化的亚瑟王时代，一个虚构的传说世界，与亚瑟王传统故事不同，这里的亚瑟王和圆桌骑士们已经堕落，成为玩家需要击败的敌人。游戏的世界观构建在一个充满黑暗与腐败的幻想世界中，玩家将扮演初出茅庐的士兵，通过不断探索各个房间并通过战斗击败腐化的敌人，逐渐获得成长，同时得到各种神灵的帮助，获得能够对抗邪恶势力的力量。游戏有趣的设定为游戏增添了厚重的背景，同时耳熟能详的亚瑟王背景故事也让玩家在战斗过程中更有代入感。 [h1]黑暗漫画风格的游戏画面[/h1] 《圣杯誓约》游戏采用了一种独特的美术风格，用黑暗风格的漫画风打造了一个沉浸感十足的黑暗幻想世界。虽然初看上去游戏非常有《哈迪斯》之类的游戏的画面影子，但是长时间游玩过后还是能够感受到游戏画面和风格上的区别。游戏中的角色和场景设计都极具辨识度，粗犷而富有个性的线条让整个世界充满了压迫感和神秘感。游戏的画面增强了玩家的视觉体验，也让游戏的战斗变得更加爽快舒适。 [h1]肉鸽元素的动作砍杀是游戏的核心玩法[/h1] 《圣杯誓约》的战斗节奏紧凑且充满挑战，核心玩法则是带有Roguelite元素的动作砍杀玩法。游戏提供了多种不同风格的人物角色供玩家选择，每个角色又拥有独特的武器和技能树。玩家需要熟练掌握轻重攻击、冲刺闪避、法术释放等机制，才能在高难度快节奏的战斗中生存下来。从我个人的游戏体验来说，本作游戏目前的EA阶段，动作流畅度不是很足，有时候明显感觉到动作的滞后性，在敌人攻击到来的眼前，明明已经按出了按键，却感觉人物的动作明显滞后，有些笨重的感觉。此外游戏默认的按键也不是很舒服，在游玩了几盘游戏后，我还是修改了默认按键。 游戏的房间选择会有通关后的奖励提示，因此玩家在游戏中可以根据自己的需求选择对应的房间进入。游戏的局外成长部分相对比较容易，哪怕玩家在一次游戏中一个BOSS也没有打到，但是却在房间中失去了大量的资源，那么在局外一样可以获得一定的成长。此外游戏的新内容解锁是根据玩家累计通关的房间数决定的，比如玩家使用初始的人物通关一定房间后就可以解锁僧侣人物，哪怕玩家一次只能通关一个房间，累积下来也可以解锁，解锁的方式相对容易一些，让玩家可以更轻松的获得新的内容体验，从而找到更加适合自己的游玩方式。 游戏的场景设计比起曾经玩过的几款肉鸽动作砍杀游戏略显狭小，并且关卡的房间中有各种环境物品会阻碍玩家的冲刺和闪避，这让玩家的行动有了很大的限制。游戏中玩家的主要攻击手段包括轻攻击、重攻击、法术攻击和必杀技攻击。其中法术攻击会消耗魔法值，因此CD时间更长，而轻攻击和重攻击的CD则比较短暂，尤其是重攻击手段，在很多武器使用中都有明显的作用。 游戏的核心局内成长机制是神灵的祝福系统。玩家可以向不同的神灵领主宣誓效忠，从而解锁超过200种独特的祝福。这些祝福可以增强玩家的战斗能力，增加玩家的基础属性或是附加一些属性攻击。在游戏中玩家需要将这些祝福与角色的武器和技能法术结合，从而形成千变万化的战斗流派，这样的肉鸽玩法极大提升了游戏的重玩价值。 [h1]多人联机合作或成本作最受期待的点[/h1] 本作游戏支持玩家单人游戏，或是多人联机合作游玩。在多人合作模式下，游戏则更加凸显了其策略性和可玩性。玩家可以邀请好友一起组队探索神秘世界，共同面对强大的敌人。通过整合各自角色的优势，形成默契的配合，共创战术，从而更加轻松地战胜敌人。多人联机合作使得游戏的战斗难度大大降低，但是满屏幕的法术技能在带给玩家一定的爽快感之外，也带给玩家一些视觉上的混乱。不过多人联机合作的玩法依然是我对本作最大的期待。 [h1]总结[/h1] 综合来看，《圣杯誓约》是一款非常出色的动作Roguelite游戏。独特的游戏背景、紧凑的战斗节奏，丰富的成长与策略元素以及备受期待的多人联机玩法，为玩家带来了爽快的游戏享受。不过，游戏目前还处于EA阶段，很多内容还有不足，同时游戏也仍存在一些需要改进和完善的地方。例如，单人游玩时难度较高，以及动作的滞后感等问题。游戏可能仍需打磨以便在未来提升游戏的体验。相信随着后续版本的更新和优化，这些问题都将得到妥善解决，让我有机会和好友们驰骋战场。 [h1][b]单人体验劣化版的哈迪斯1[/b][/h1] 我们先来回忆一下哈迪斯1为什么成功？ 个人认为最重要的两点，一是哈迪斯1足够爽——从堡垒和晶体管沿袭下来的优秀打击感，加上带上饰品后，削减了随机性、取而代之近乎定向的构筑，让局内BD成型难度低。低热度下，或许最终构筑并不完美，但也能愉快通关。 二是迄今为止，其他学习者仍难以忘其项背的文本剧情量。低随机性构筑+过多的局外资源需求对一款肉鸽游戏来说会削减游戏寿命，但哈迪斯1的一系列故事、对话、NPC好感度，弥补了这一缺陷。 [hr][/hr] 那我们回过头来看圣杯誓约，可以说是有样学样、照搬了哈迪斯1的皮毛——16种武器和技能，局内构筑也是通过神选和铁砧来成型，以及需求量非常大的局外资源。 但游戏目前存在非常致命的缺点。首先，将近200种的祝福，却无法定向选择自己想要的祝福方向——这很重要，即便游戏里存在双重祝福，但无法带来质变且解锁条件成谜；倘若没有刷到双重祝福，不同派别的祝福之间是无法形成有效联动的。这就导致构筑池污染严重，刷不到想要的祝福选项，就谈不上BD成型，那么一局游戏会玩得很便秘。并且有太多的局外资源房间占用了一局的游戏流程，让本就难构筑成型的局内体验雪上加霜。 其次，部分武器设计得很失败，点名批评前锋的手炮——轻攻击将近2秒的攻速、连续5发就会过热直接缴械，却不能换来极远的射程和优秀的AOE效果，可以说这个轻攻击怎么用怎么别扭，不如直接重攻击抡起大炮砸死敌人来的实在有效。 至于高难度体验，腐化带来过多的场地干扰设计实在是过于败笔，怪物各种远程和高频攻击本就让玩家分身乏术、难以抽出攻击时间，对于单人体验来说十分的不友好，难度曲线堪忧。 最后，游戏里目前的剧情自然谈不上有剧情。游戏眼下的内容量实在是支撑不了长时间反复游玩的动力，看后续的更新和修复力度吧。

[h1]《圣杯誓约》：亚瑟王莫回头，回眸便是咱无名之辈来斩杀！[/h1] 不得不说自哈迪斯爆火之后，该题材是受到了诸多厂商青睐并予以制作，本作多多少少也是有所参考，玩家也是在这亚瑟王传奇背景下开展一场杀出“冥界”之旅，噢是那圣杯，要做的就是为了那美好的明天，附身不同职业角色石像，用各异武器净化被腐化的圆桌骑士，最终直面狮心王亚瑟，解决混乱源头并夺取圣杯，奶奶滴，吃咱一记！ 本作画风会略显“崩坏”，这不是说美工不得行，更多是说偏于暗黑写实，这也是故事背景所致，污痕圣杯的真相是什么，需要玩家不断死亡再生进而挑战，没有踏不平的路！那么这就要补给变强啦，利用好场外因素方能提高容错率嘛，这里玩家也是在根据地可以找NPC们解锁对应职业的各种武器如游侠弓剑等三种武器随意选择并且通过改造强化可以使得武器在各方面在数值加持下用得更加得心应手，提升攻速、攻击力或带来与武器契合的增益那是基操，部分还有专门针对轻重攻击的机制切换，芜湖还能这么玩，这也使得玩家的出招套路更加灵活自主。当然，法术也是不能少，玩家也可解锁而切换搭配，天赋树那是按照类别来分成，也是随玩家进度来逐步解锁，有生命加成、有闪避多段、房间探索奖励提高、复活等等，可以说有了他们，手再残，低难度通关那是轻松拿捏，多周目挑战那还是需要操作的。 战斗上基本也是一个房间推土机而后可以根据房间门上的指示物知晓门背后的是什么来定夺自己此次的目标或挑战奖励，商店、挑战那是基操，部分还有限时生存、浇水培育等给玩家带来不少新鲜体验，这个过程中玩家就要开始操作起来啦，抓住敌人攻击的各种前摇，利用近战攻击、远程射击和魔法技能相互结合打输出，基本就是一套又一套下送敌人归西，而这个探索过程场内最大的帮助那必须是祝福，神灵相助全看玩家选择，流派也基本在这里，祝福一般就是围绕玩家的轻击、重击、冲刺、法术等来提供额外加成，有传统物理提高、也有赋予毒气、烧伤、冰冻等全看玩家如何搭配，后续还能够不断升级甚至于献祭替换，品质也是一大关键嘛，这些祝福不仅能带来数值上的提升，还会在玩法上产生显著变化，玩家能根据战斗环境和敌人配置灵活调整战术，大大增强了游戏的可玩性与重玩价值，每次结束而后再战，那便是新的开始。 整体而言，本作借鉴了不少但也在自己的背景下打造了属于自己独特的玩法和丰富的内容，神灵赐予我祝福吧，肉鸽就是得劲，有兴趣的玩家不妨一试。 [h1][quote=] [table] [tr] [th] 欢迎关注 [b][u][i]U_U鉴赏家培养计划[/i][/u][/b][/th] [/tr] [tr] [th] 关注U_U鉴赏家，开启精彩游戏之旅。 [/th] [/tr] [/table] [/quote][/h1]

Being as NICE as humanly possible here. I really dont mean to disrespect the developers because its not my intention, but I'm sure they're well aware of this. This is basically Hades, without hit-stun on enemies, and alot more bogged down. It's interesting, It's different, It's fun, sure I can give all that to it, but I would be incredibly dishonest to say it is anything but Hades vs Hades at Home. It's definitely a walmart version of an already existing game. I would really enjoy it if it had a lot of unique powers and styles, but honestly, it's very basic to its core. I would also enjoy it more if it was MORE like Hades and non-armored enemies actually get staggered, and dashing had more I-Frames than it does, because its lacking heavily with the dash mechanic, Bigger arena's, including boss arenas, More UI visual indicators, etc.. First Major boss Big dude with an Axe, Does a whirlwind, and if he decides to start it while you're near a corner, you're basically forced to eat a ton of damage, ontop of a very small arena to begin with. The main selling point of this is Co-Op. Which is the only really hugely positive thing that can be given to it. Did you wonder what its like to Play Hades but with your Friends? This is that.... kinda, just not as good, but you can still play with friends! It's decent but I'd say this is more of a $9.99 game than a $24.99 game and I wouldn't see myself being interested in buying it with that price tag personally. Recommending SOLELY because of Co-Op and Co-Op alone. Otherwise I'd just tell you to play Hades, sorry bros. Also Wealth upgrade tree is abysmal. I would rework that entire tree. +10 gold per level for a huge amount of gems, +1 gold income from cleared rooms for tons of gems and on 3 seperate nodes. With the cost of items, this is even worse than Hades, full honest. Hades at its lowest is start with 100g lol. You also get gold from random things, gold rooms in this game are the biggest skip of my life because they are honestly so unworth it. The starting gold should be like +20-40 per node and the income should be +2-3 minimum per node. 25 hp heal costs 50 gold. New skills cost ~200 gold. Minor upgrades cost ~100 gold. This doesn't pan out properly. It's a complete and utter waste of a skill upgrade tree honestly. It should be competitive with the others. Honestly all the tree upgrades are ruthlessly expensive in comparison to the difficulty of the game. I've almost beat the end boss and I havent even gotten close to finishing a single skill tree, It requires so many runs to get so many gems, and so many other items, silk for cosmetics, shards for weapons, embers for unlocks, etc. I just dont feel like we're given enough for how much there is content wise. Kinda feels more like a mobile game than a roguelite with how much expectancy is to come for grinding out items. If I actually played with other people, we would have absolutely beat this game 100% within the first couple tries. I barely struggle solo so I cant see it being much harder with more capable bodies. Just food for thought. Would 100% consider the values being moderately increased on all the upgrade currency. People wanna unlock stuff and have fun, but it feels counter productive if you can beat the main portion of the game before getting to that point. Hades forced you to keep coming back to figure out the story, but it was a big selling point for that game, not so much story going on in this one. 4 chars, 4 weapons for each char so all those need to be unlocked then upgraded, probably 4 spells per character aswell, etc. I havent bothered with the other classes yet, just havent cared for anything but the classic sword guy.

I see tons of people saying is a Hades copy, but I think the best way to say it is "inspired", because the game itself has a lot of particularities and unique things and has yet a lot to come in future updates. I'm really enjoying it, especially with my friends, but you can play it alone and is still awesome, especially if you want to upgrade your character. I didn't have any problems with multiplayer, the server is good.

圣杯誓约给我的第一感觉就是哈迪斯既视感，后者是为了见母亲努力逃出父亲设置的重重障碍，前者则是为了收复被腐化的亚瑟和圆桌骑士统治的地方。获得精灵的祝福激发潜能从而击败敌人，给我感觉两者最大的区别就是能不能联机的区别了，就是喜欢爽玩这类动作肉鸽游戏。 作为一款肉鸽游戏，本作有着丰富的局内祝福以及局外加成，局外的属性对应着玩家在游戏中获得的几种资源（月之石、圣杯之水、仙子余烬以及水晶碎片）其中仙子余烬用来解锁角色，法术和武器；水晶碎片则是解锁源力，让玩家在战斗的时候可以更好的应对敌人，源力又分为生命、战争、财富、宝藏和风险；圣杯之水可以用来强化武器，用以更好的对线敌人；月之石则提供独特的强化，让玩家对抗国王军可以更加游刃有余，更加充满刺激和挑战。 而在游戏中所提升主要就是通过关卡获得各种祝福，当然商店也可以购买祝福，但是金币很缺，没有特定的打资源祝福，那么整局的钱包都是瘪的。 本作目前有四个角色可供玩家体验，初始只有一个角色可以玩，其他角色需要玩家相继解锁，一起通过房间才能解锁角色。每个角色又有四种武器可以操作，不同的武器给人的感觉都是不一样的，就拿游侠来说，棍剑弓环刃得心应手。除了人物可以获得强化提升外，每把武器也可以获得提升，看似只有4个英雄，实则可以给到玩家十六种体验。 游戏中每过四个房间就会遭遇传说野怪每九个房间就有圆桌骑士来袭，每次过完房间都有不同的奖励，当然在战斗前夕奖励都是可以被看到的，所以玩家可以根据奖励来决定自己要走哪条路。 随着游戏的首通，则可以解锁更难的难度，更高难度除了数值有所提升之外，每章也会额外多一个boss，这也许就是团队合作的意义所在吧，如果单人游玩的话，难度是有点偏大的。 目前可以体验的东西还蛮多的，打击感这方面也还不错，就是难度偏大，也比较肝，其他就都挺好的。 [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]

I got Sworn in a Humble Bundle, which is basically the gaming equivalent of opening a mystery can from your food storage and hoping it’s chili and not peaches. I installed it with zero expectations, zero hype, and honestly zero idea what the game even was. After playing for a while, I found myself asking the most important question a gamer can ask: “Am I having fun?” Answer: Kinda. Then I asked a deeper question: “Do I feel like I have purpose?” Answer: Kinda. Then I spiraled into a full existential evaluation: Are the characters fun? Kinda. Is the gear interesting? Kinda. Are the upgrades satisfying? Kinda. Are the levels unique? …ehhh kinda-ish. Are the mobs memorable? If by memorable you mean I forgot them immediately, then yes. To be fair, it looks like a lot of effort went into the game—like someone really cared… until they got to designing the levels and regular enemies and said, “Alright, just copy-paste that a few dozen times, ship it.” BUT—credit where it’s due—the bosses are actually pretty solid. They feel like the devs woke up from a nap and said, “Oh right, we should try again here.” I only played solo, so maybe this game secretly becomes amazing with friends. Maybe there’s laughter, teamwork, and epic moments. Or maybe it’s just four people simultaneously saying “kinda” in voice chat. Do I recommend it? Kinda. Final verdict: This is the most “6.5/10 but I don’t regret it” game I’ve played in a while.

设计这游戏的策划绝对没玩过肉鸽，玩nm呢？ 这游戏也配叫Roguelike？我看叫“Rogue爬行”还差不多，因为玩家就像个弱智一样被策划按在地上摩擦，爬都爬不起来。 先说你那逆天的局内成长。打一把下来，75%的奖励都是“武器强化素材”、“人物解锁碎片”、“基础属性+1”这种傻卵局外道具。我打完Boss你给我一根毛？单局内提升约等于零，爽感？不存在的。从头刮痧刮到尾，每把都在裸奔，这他妈是肉鸽还是上班打卡？玩家是在玩你的养成系统，不是在玩肉鸽！ 再说你那近战设计，简直是对我智商的侮辱。没有像样的回血手段，战损完全控不住，拿到吸血Buff是神，拿不到就是条死狗。整个体验全看神秘商店roll不roll吸血，这叫策略？这叫博彩！近战玩家就是你在关卡里放的会走路的沙包，建议你把近战角色直接删了，省得恶心人。 还有你那所谓的体系，有个屁的联动。各玩各的，像是几个不相干的人在打麻将，强行凑一起。玩家想build？对不起，没门。你只能被动接受策划喂的屎，然后祈祷别太噎死。 最后，局外养成堆得跟山一样高。武器强化、人物解锁、基础数值、甚至连外观都要刷。你是做肉鸽还是做MMO？数值全靠局外撑着，局内就是坨答辩。打一把成长全在局外，打完毫无成就感，只有“终于又肝完一局”的疲软感。 总结： 这游戏的策划，要么是压根没玩过肉鸽，要么就是故意把玩家当韭菜割。玩法空洞、成长畸形、设计脑残。想爽？别想了，这游戏就是用来耗你时间的。不推荐，赶紧跑！

Ok, didn't want to do it this way, but there are no other options I can find (and I don't care if they exist, STEAM...). Truly, this game is great. In solo, runs great, fun to play, all the accolades. Well done. Multiplayer is where the issues are abundant and very obvious. I was playing with friends. All of us know our way around an internet connections. And yet, every time I play with them, everyone but the host has horrible lag. I have it so bad I can reliably avoid damage just because the hitboxes for the enemies simply... don't connect. Unfortunately, if that were the worst issue, this would be irritating but deal-with-able. It does not end there. I was at the altar in the... I forget the words, fountain area, and my friends and I were exchanging blessings before the final boss. I went to the altar, gave a blessing, took a blessing. When I got out, hard locked. Couldn't move, couldn't go to the door to let my friends activate exiting the room. I had to quit out of the game. So, I quit out and opened the game again, and this is the third and final issue. Most of the time a game will let you join runs in progress if you had to leave. This would be the acceptable half measure. Unfortunately, that does not exist in this game... Truly, I enjoy playing, and this is a great option for me and my friends. But between the lag, the hard locking, and the lack of resuming in progress runs... I can't say this game is worth it. This shouldn't be in 1.0 right now.

Great game, but unfortunately should still be in early access and has a lot to improve on. Major Complaints: -Definitely needs some sort of save system to continue a run. I understand a room reset might be too easy to abuse but at least the fountains could be save points? -Disconnects will cause an entire run to forfeited. -Runs can also be bricked by rewards spawning in walls or unreachable places. You have to collect these rewards to move on so you are just stuck if this happens. Minor Complaints: -Cursor is very hard to see sometimes and no accessibility settings to change its color or appearance. -Speaking of hard to see, I HATE the traps. They blend in to the environment too well and some are hidden in corners (so a wall or something visually blocks 90% of the trap). It's also disheartening that enemies can trigger the traps to hurt you. -It's a bit annoying that you are locked to whatever blessing type you choose first for each slot (eg once I get shade on dash, i can never get anything else on dash) - we end up abandoning a lot of runs early if we get stuck with poor choices. Overall the game has great bones but needs a little more love before being considered complete.

If you're planning to play SWORN solo, keep your expectations in check—this is a mid-level Hades clone through and through, and it isn't nearly as good as the original. The isometric combat and room-clearing loops are okay, but without friends to back you up, the gameplay flaws and slower pacing become a lot more noticeable. It’s an okay game for a casual solo playthrough, but it firmly sits in the shadow of the game it's mimicking.

[h2]Summary:[/h2] I'd recommend grabbing SWORN on sale. It can be a lot of fun as a Hades-like action game, but it'd seriously benefit from some quality of life changes: [h2]1) Add a dedicated Boss Rush mode.[/h2] Make Boss Rush mode accessible from the beginning. Having to go through the majority of the game to do Boss Rush feels tedious, it takes approx. ~15-30 minutes to get there. It's a fun mode to do, but it's buried deep within the game. [h2]2) Add the option to re-join Co-op games.[/h2] If you disconnect from an ongoing co-op game, you can't rejoin. If the Host disconnects, everybody disconnects, and you gotta start all over again. I was briefly disconnected from a good co-op run earlier today, then I couldn't rejoin. Lots of folks in the forums have echoed similar issues. Co-op feels janky/fragile and a little buggy. Certain skills & abilities can cause frame loss and lag people. [h2]3) Solo Mode: Add the option to save your progress mid-run.[/h2] Unlike the Hades games, mid-run saving isn't an option. Players can't completely close out the game & resume later where they last left off. An average run can take between ~15-45 minutes, make sure you can commit the time to do a full run. If your game crashes, you're starting over from the beginning. Please add this! [h2]4) Add the option to skip Boss Introduction sequences.[/h2] Please add an option to "Hold X to skip" during boss intro sequences. If you've beaten the game & cleared every boss, you've still got to sit through their boss intro sequences, with no ability to skip them. Changing this would improve the flow of every run.

Clearly inspired by Hades and while not a bad game it's just not as good as Hades in pretty much every respect. It lacks the polish and story that makes Hades such an immersive experience coupled with a few infuriating development choices. Very strong Hades at home energy, which isn't bad if you're done with Hades and crave more of it. Coop also works pretty well, that's something Hades can't give you. Though 4 player coop can get a little hectic with the extra pets the game adds. Eight friendly entities running around in addition to all the mobs is hard to parse at times. The bad: - On the controller at least continue dialog and accept are bound to the same key. So as you're going through dialog that ends in a choice you can easily double press, accepting the first option without really choosing. - Lots of weapons have a power up mechanic. This sits directly at odds with the pace of the game. Non charged attacks are just more optimal as you can keep moving. You can't dodge and charge. - Lack of ability to rebind controls. Combined with some baffling keybind choices this is workable but annoying. It's not a bad game, Hades is just flat out better.
